name: Hoshi no Furu Toki
source:
When the protagonist Hasekura Akane was 10 years old she was given a sparkling jewel fragment by a mysterious beautiful woman.
But in the blink of an eye, that women and the jewel both disappeared and thinking it was a dream Akane forgot all about it.
And 7 years passed.

Akane is now 17 years old and a second year in high school.
Whenever thoughts of a boy make her heart flutter that sparkling jewel fragment appears in the palm of her hand.
And along with that she feels a strange presence watching her.

The cause is the owner of a dark gem that is opposed to the sparkling gem fragment that Akane has.
Apparently in two weeks a comet will pass by and the dark gem will unleash it's power and cover the world in darkness.

Various mysterious men appear around Akane because of the two gems.
Will she fall in love or get betrayed?
Will Akane be able to defend the world from the power of darkness?
[Translated from the [url=http://www.otomate.jp/home/game/spec/?hard=ps2&title=hoshitoki]official site[/url]]
translation:
支仓茜十岁时，一位神秘美丽的女人送给她一块闪闪发光的宝石碎片。
可转眼之间，女人与宝石都消失了。茜以为那只是一场梦，渐渐将一切忘却。
七年过去。

如今，茜17岁，是一名高中二年级学生。每当男孩令她心跳加速时，那块闪耀的宝石碎片便会出现在她掌心。与此同时，她还会感受到某种诡异的存在正在注视着自己。

这一切的始作俑者，是一块与茜持有的闪耀宝石相对立的黑暗宝石的主人。据说两周后，一颗彗星将掠过地球，而黑暗宝石会释放力量，将世界笼罩在黑暗之中。

由于两块宝石，茜身边出现了形形色色的神秘男子。她会坠入爱河，还是遭到背叛？茜能否抵挡黑暗之力，守护世界？
[译自[url=http://www.otomate.jp/home/game/spec/?hard=ps2&title=hoshitoki]官方网站[/url]]
